title: Locked 2019-2022 retrospective reservoir evaluation
station_cohort: The same 89 general downstream-flow gauges registered in 20260828_19; the four spatial extrapolation stations remain excluded.
parameter_selection: No refit, reselection, threshold revision or observation assimilation is permitted after opening 2019-2022.
decision_rule: R2 becomes the TN reservoir hydrology interface if it passes all four frozen noninferiority limits. Improvement is reported separately and is not required because the registered objective is state consistency. If R2 fails, retain the no-reservoir parent for TN and report the reservoir structure as retrospective-confounded.
claim_boundary: This is a locked retrospective temporal check, not independent external validation and not identification of individual reservoir releases.
